notes.title: We are still with you!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, welcome to the Hentai EroCum development team!

It's been a week since the game's release and we want to thank everyone for supporting our first game - we really appreciate it!

Today we've released a small update that fixes some bugs and also adds the ability to skip and the "shake the picture" mechanic with the "Enter" key. This way, you can go through the puzzle without using your mouse)

Now we're working on increasing the resolution of the images, as well as a new project, which will be much larger and more complex than the usual puzzle - we're learning and want to develop our product.

Also a reminder that there is a poll in the "discussion" section for additional location and 6 new images that will be added for free. At the moment a popular theme is "nurses and hospitals", if you want to suggest your own, we would be very happy to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549672/25484771d5ae095f84931e7841d19813be4bb26e.png[/img]

Thanks again to everyone who supports us, we really appreciate it!

Have a great day and weekend!

- Hentai EroCum development team

notes.title: Version 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Good afternoon! Welcome to the development team Hentai EroCum!

Today became available the first version of our game, which you can buy now and the first week at a discount!

We made some last minute changes based on feedback from respected curators:
[list]
[*] Added ability to adjust music sound in game
[*] Possibility of correct exit in menu and exit the game with "Escape" key
[*] Changed the order of image themes
[*] Small edits
[/list]

We plan to release a patch containing higher resolution images, as well as edits based on first user feedback.

In addition, we plan to release a free update containing an additional location created based on the wishes of our players. Your wishes regarding location themes and pictures you can leave in corresponding discussion section of our community :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549672/96a2222ca2002433f4d110a59452bdf30f8bf6fc.png[/img]

We thank everyone who supported us and we will try to improve what we have now and give you more good emotions and beautiful girls)

Thank you very much, have a good day and weekend!

- Hentai EroCum development team
- Deni_Sele

notes.title: Game release tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Hentai EroCum will be released tomorrow, February 24th, Friday.

Uncovering our last two puzzle themes: the office and public transport. The further away, the hotter the images :)

Within a week after the release we plan to update the game with major fixes and add your suggestions. We will also add images in higher resolution (1k -> 2k).
And also announce a special surprise for all those who have bought the game.

Thanks to everyone who supported us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549672/c9a5f980b0fb796afa8727bce48db8e2f753a6c3.png[/img]

- Hentai EroCum development team

notes.title: Updated languages and revealed puzzle themes!
notes.notes:
We have updated the supported languages for the store page to make it more convenient for you. 
Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, Ukrainian, Polish and German have been added.

We also reveal the finished themed locations for our puzzle - ready art for the university, beach, sports and cafe themes. The 2 remaining themes are kept secret for now :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549672/316366c5e692ce632c91c5c0949d24552b5b324a.png[/img]


Thank you for your support!
Thanks for adding to the wishlist and subscribing.
Have a great Monday and week!

notes.title: Hello everyone!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We got approval in steam and now you can enjoy the beautiful page in the store.

Briefly repeating the description of the game, for those who have forgotten:
Hentai EroCum is a relaxing puzzle game.
The game has 6 different themes, 36 sexy girls and over 80 beautiful and erotic images.
Enjoy charming pictures of girls and relaxing music.
Complete the puzzle and then shake the picture to reveal more explicit content.

Achievements are letters of the English alphabet and numbers - collect the word you want!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549672/702ff5ce8eec1ee67dbe097b4352aad0ad7f61bf.png[/img]


That's it, we'll be uploading the trailer and new screenshots soon. 

Appreciate adding to your wish list and subscribing.

See you around!
